axiom_gate.reason: The result is a representation-theoretic consequence of the already-derived full Hodge group.

hard_boundaries: Hodge-generic is not the same as a Zariski-generic point.
Picard rank one does not by itself identify the Prym polarization as a primitive integral generator.
The integral NS lattice depends on polarization type up to finite index.
The formula counts Hodge classes, not all cohomology classes.
No P000 or Foundation promotion is made.
